# Case file field reference

Every field found in a case file, what reads it, where the learner meets it, and the
section of `docs/case-authoring-requirements.md` that governs it. Generated from the
packs and `engine/field_notes.py`; the 'reads' column is a scan of the code for the
field's name (generic names such as `id` and `when` are not scanned).

**How to read 'sees'.** `splash` before Begin. `list` on the case list. `history` the
History tab. `monitor`, `figure`, `sound` the room. `chart` the running record and the
exam, results and consult panels. `nurse` the nurse's line. `button` an action or
handoff button. `debrief` after the run. `end` the end screen. `no` acts but is never
printed. `never` nothing reads it: a note to the reviewing physician.

**Fields that are notes.** Any key named `note`, `notes`, `authoring_note`,
`author_note`, `author_rationale`, `verify`, `rationale`, `source`, or ending in
`_note`, is free text for the reviewer wherever it appears. Nothing reads it. Write it
freely and keep clinical reasoning for the reviewer there, not in a learner-visible
field. Free-form blocks (`phase_notes`, `interview.authoring_notes`, `provenance`,
`authored_against`, `catalog_change_requests`) are the same.
